identity.why: the persona's panel and scale, and the maximized window made of them (the core's zoom.stealth.screen.* and layout.css.devPixelsPerPx); the body is as wide as the window. Only leaves a seed moves: colorDepth, pixelDepth, availTop, availLeft, top, left and the orientation are every persona's and are held to retail

the declared window and screen in each driven state (ci_host_gate.py INVARIANTS hold their relations); an event's screen - client is where the window puts the viewport. In fullscreen the window is the screen, at the origin: those positions and offsets are every persona's and are held to retail

the declared GPU: its name, and the vertex uniform and sample limits the persona's GPU gives (ANGLE gives NVIDIA one vertex uniform vector less); every other limit and the WebGPU adapters are every persona's and are held to retail

reference_machine.why: where the retail reference's own window sat (16 px in from the screen at 100 percent, not maximized); the declared maximized window's content starts at 0 on every persona
the speech voices the reference machine's Windows had installed (English and Italian); the core declares the session language's list, the same for every seed

measurement.why: retail was measured on a hidden desktop, where its window never has focus

known_defects.why: phase 4: text from idwr (DWrite 26100) on every OS; today Windows asks the host's DWrite and Linux FreeType. Only the rasterised glyphs, their advances and ink extents and the serif/monospace fallback widths differ (firefox-59 dumps): text.adjust, text.fonts, text.rect, text.units and the vertical metrics are held
WebGL draws through the host's driver (llvmpipe here, ANGLE on Windows); a host-independent rasterizer is its own project
